events.text: From the highest heaven you can see every world at once, stacked like bowls. Heaven's law will let you go down into one of them, sealed small, for a while. Which?

choices.text: Go down to the world below, where it all began

effects.log: You look for a long time at the small green world under all the clouds.

choices.text: Go down to the Upper Realm, among the immortals

effects.log: The floating isles, the Jade Court, the place you were once new.

choices.text: Go down to the Divine Realm, among the gods

effects.log: The domains of the gods, where you once had to fight for a name.

choices.text: Stay where you are

effects.log: You stay. The worlds below go on turning, and do not know you looked.

events.text: The road is dust and the sky is low. You had forgotten how heavy air is down here, and how loud. A farmer passes with an ox and nods to you as to anyone. For {adc_years} years, you are anyone.

choices.text: Walk on as nobody

effects.log: You walk on as nobody, and it is the lightest you have felt in ten thousand years.

choices.text: Let one person see what you are

effects.log: You let the next person you meet see you, only for a breath. They will tell it all their life, and nobody will believe them.

events.text: The road again, the dust again. A song in the rice terraces that you remember being new. Somewhere ahead is everything you left, a little older every time.

events.text: The isles drift past you as they did on your first day above the clouds, when you were nobody and afraid of the edges. You are sealed now to the strength of an Immortal Sovereign. Up here, that is still a great deal.

events.text: The domains hang in the void like lamps. You walk the road of stars between them, sealed to the strength of an Ancient God, and the gods you pass do not look twice. They have never seen a Dao Ancestor. They do not know they are seeing one now.

events.text: A year in {adc_world}. The roads go to {adc_sect}, to the villages where your blood may still live, to old ruins, and to wherever the world is in trouble. Heaven's law allows one deed a year.

choices.text: Go to {adc_sect}

effects.log: You go to the old places.

choices.text: Look for your blood

effects.log: You go looking for the ones who carry your blood.

choices.text: Look in on the head of your old house

effects.log: You go to see who is running your house, and how.

choices.text: Seek a relic of the old world

effects.log: You go looking for what only the oldest roads remember.

choices.text: Answer the world's trouble

effects.log: You go toward the trouble.

choices.text: Walk the roads with no purpose

effects.log: You walk all day and arrive nowhere. It does your heart good.

choices.text: Go back up

effects.log: Enough. You fold yourself small and go back up.

events.text: A year among the isles. Paths of cloud go to the Jade Court where you once stood at the back, to grottoes older than the court, and to the isles that are burning.

events.text: A year among the domains. A stair of starlight goes to the hall of the pantheons, to the dead domains where old things lie, and to wherever the gods are at war.

events.text: This year's deed is done. Heaven's law allows one, and you can feel it watching for a second. The night is warm, and the roads will still be here next year.

choices.text: Sit by the road until morning

effects.log: You sit until morning. A night-bird keeps you company and then leaves.

choices.text: Go back up

effects.log: You fold yourself small and go back up.

events.text: The {adc_sect} still stands where it stood. Your portrait hangs above its altar, so old the paint has cracked, and the face in it is nobody's now. A young disciple sweeping the yard asks if you have come to join. "You look a bit old," the disciple adds, kindly.

choices.text: Show them who you were

effects.log: You tell the elders one thing only you could know. The bell is rung nine times. Nobody sleeps that night.

choices.text: Sit at the back of the morning lesson

effects.log: You sit at the back. They teach your old form badly, and lovingly. You do not correct it.

choices.text: Leave one stance corrected on the practice post

effects.log: In the night you carve one small mark on the practice post. In a hundred years it will be the sect's greatest secret.

events.text: Back at the {adc_sect}. The disciples are fighting about which of them is the genius. The genius is the quiet one in the corner, as it always is. Nobody has noticed yet.

choices.text: Speak to the quiet one

effects.log: You say three sentences to the quiet one in the corner. Years from now, they will be the only three that mattered.

choices.text: Let them find their own way

effects.log: You leave them to it. It is the hardest kindness there is.

events.text: The village where you were born is a town now, with a stone bridge and two temples. The well you fell into as a child is still crooked. Children are daring each other to look down it.

choices.text: Tell the children a true story

effects.log: You tell them about a child who fell in this very well and climbed out and kept climbing. They do not believe a word.

choices.text: Draw a bucket and drink

effects.log: The water tastes exactly as it did. You had not known you remembered.

events.text: At the Jade Court the new immortals stand at the back, as you once stood, and learn who hates whom. An old immortal you once sparred with is still in the second row. Ten thousand years, and still in the second row.

choices.text: Let the old one recognise you

effects.log: The old immortal looks at you for a long time, then laughs until the court goes silent. "I knew you would not stay small," they say.

choices.text: Stand at the back with the new ones

effects.log: You stand at the back and are told, sternly, to stop smiling during the ceremony.

choices.text: Whisper one word to a frightened newcomer

effects.log: You tell a frightened newcomer the one thing nobody told you. Their shoulders come down an inch.

events.text: The hall of the pantheons. Twelve thrones of light, and the gods in them arguing over a domain the size of a teacup. One throne has a crack in it you made, long ago. Someone has tried to polish it out.

choices.text: Sit in the cracked throne a moment

effects.log: You sit. The argument stops. When you stand and leave, nobody can remember what it was about.

choices.text: Watch from the doorway

effects.log: You watch from the doorway like a servant. Gods, it turns out, are much the same as sect elders.

events.text: You find {npc} in a small courtyard, lighting incense at a family shrine. {He} does not know your face. The oldest tablet on the shrine has your name on it, spelled a little wrong.

choices.text: Leave a blessing on the house

effects.log: You touch the gatepost as you leave. For three generations, nothing bad will come through it.

choices.text: Tell {him} the truth

effects.log: {npc} hears you out, and then bows so low {his} forehead touches the shrine step. {He} asks you to stay for dinner. You do.

choices.text: Only ask the way, and go

effects.log: You ask the way to the next town. {npc} gives good directions and a cup of water. That is enough.

events.text: {npc} is teaching a child the opening stance in the yard, the one you taught your own children. It has changed over the generations. It is better now.

choices.text: Show the child one small thing

effects.log: You show the child how to set the back foot. {npc} watches, puzzled, and then very quiet.

choices.text: Watch from the road

effects.log: You watch from the road until the lesson ends. The child falls over twice and gets up twice.

events.text: {npc}, your child, is old now, older than you were when you went up the mountain. {He} is sitting in the sun outside the house, and {he} looks up at you, and {he} knows. Of course {he} knows.

choices.text: Sit with {him} until evening

effects.log: You sit with {npc} until evening and say very little. It is the best day of the last ten thousand years.

choices.text: Tell {him} everything

effects.log: You tell {npc} everything. {He} listens like a child at bedtime, and falls asleep before the end, smiling.

events.text: The ancestral hall of {adc_house} leaks, and the ledgers are worse. {adc_fool} holds the seal and spends the evenings at cards. In the back room {adc_good} is doing the sums again, without being asked. The elders meet at the new moon. Nobody here knows the stranger at the gate has a tablet at the top of their shrine.

choices.text: Say one sentence in the right ear

effects.log: You find the eldest elder at the well, and say one sentence.

choices.text: Let the house find its own way

effects.log: You leave the gate as you found it. A house that cannot mend itself cannot be mended from above. You tell yourself that all the way down the road.

events.text: Two of your blood sit at one table. {adc_fool}, with the seal, is telling the tenants the rents will double. {adc_good}, at the far end, has already worked out how many of them will leave. Heaven's law watches for exactly this: one quiet push, and a whole house goes another way.

choices.text: Push, once, and quietly

effects.log: You let the elders overhear a stranger asking who keeps the sums here.

choices.text: Finish your tea and go

effects.log: You finish your tea. It is poor tea. You pay for it and go.

events.text: The village gives you the name without being asked: {adc_kin}, of the old family, at the house with the good roof. You watch from the road through one whole morning. The walk is yours. So is the way of setting down a load, a little to the left.

choices.text: Leave a blessing on the house

effects.log: You touch the gatepost as you leave. For three generations, nothing bad will come through it.

choices.text: Only watch, and go

effects.log: You watch until the morning is over and go on down the road, lighter.

events.text: At the river market a stranger is haggling over rope, badly, and laughing about it. Someone calls out "{adc_kin}!" and the whole set of that head turns exactly as your own once did. Nobody at this stall has any idea who is standing next to them.

choices.text: Buy the rope, and leave it at their door

effects.log: A coil of good rope turns up at the door of {adc_kin} that night. Nobody ever finds out who paid for it.

choices.text: Tell the truth, once

effects.log: You say one thing only your blood could know. {adc_kin} goes very quiet, and then asks if you have eaten.

events.text: Your blood has run so far down the years that you cannot tell it from anyone else's. But in a farming valley there is a family that carries your surname, and a shrine with your tablet at the very top.

choices.text: Mend their roof in the night

effects.log: In the morning the roof is mended and the rice store is full. The family argues happily about which neighbour did it.

choices.text: Bow to your own tablet

effects.log: You bow to your own tablet. It is a strange thing to do. It helps more than you expected.

events.text: An old village teacher tells you, unasked, that every family in the valley claims descent from an immortal who went up the mountain long ago. "Most of them are lying," he says. "But one of them is not."

choices.text: Ask him which one

effects.log: He points to the poorest house in the valley. You leave it something that will keep it from being poor again.

choices.text: Let it stay a story

effects.log: You let it stay a story. Stories outlive families.

events.text: In a hut that fell in before the first sect was founded, under ten thousand years of leaves: {adc_relic}. Whoever wrote the first manual of qi wore this stone hollow writing it.

choices.text: Take it with you

effects.log: You take it. It feels as if it was waiting.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever this world grows next

effects.log: You leave it where it lies, and walk away lighter.

events.text: The oldest hall of the murim is a ring of stones in a field. Under the field, if you know where to listen, is {adc_relic}. It still hums when someone below trains well.

choices.text: Take it with you

effects.log: You take it. It feels as if it was waiting.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever this world grows next

events.text: In a crack beside the oldest mountain path: {adc_relic}. The first person who ever walked the jianghu for the joy of it left it here, and walked on barefoot.

choices.text: Take it with you

events.text: On the oldest isle, too small for any faction to want, {adc_relic} is still burning. Nobody has fed it in an age. It does not seem to need anyone.

choices.text: Take it with you

effects.log: You leave it where it lies, and walk away lighter.

events.text: On a ledge above the clouds, still warm: {adc_relic}. You have found its like before, empty. This one has tea in it, as if its owner just stepped away.

choices.text: Take it with you

events.text: In the ruined first hall of the Jade Court, before there was a court: {adc_relic}. Whoever carved it believed the immortals could be governed. The crack says they could not.

choices.text: Take it with you

events.text: In the dust of a domain that fell before the pantheons had names: {adc_relic}, glowing like a small sun. It is warm in the hand, like a living thing.

choices.text: Take it with you

events.text: On the empty throne of a god who chose to end rather than rule: {adc_relic}. The gods do not speak of that one. You find you would have liked them.

choices.text: Take it with you

events.text: At the very edge of the void, in the palm of a statue no god remembers raising: {adc_relic}. It is all that is left of a world that came before all the worlds.

choices.text: Take it with you

effects.log: You take it. It feels as if it was waiting.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever this world grows next

events.text: The {adc_sect} is besieged. An alliance of sects has camped at the foot of its mountain for a month, and tonight they mean to take the gate. Leading them is {adc_foe}, as strong as anyone below. Within the seal, so are you.

choices.text: Fight within the seal, as strong as this world allows

effects.log: You step in, sealed, no stronger than the strongest here.

choices.text: Break the seal (heaven's lightning, heaven's notice, and you must go home)

effects.log: You break the seal.

choices.text: Stand aside: it is not your world any more

effects.log: You do not move.

events.text: Out of the north comes {adc_foe}: beasts of every size, driven mad by something nobody has named. A river city with a hundred thousand people stands in its way, and its walls were built for bandits.

events.text: Someone has paid for your blood to end. Tonight {adc_foe} are coming over the walls of a courtyard where a family that carries your name sleeps. They do not know who they are related to. They do not know anything yet.

events.text: Ten thousand years ago, {adc_foe} humiliated you before the whole Jade Court. They have heard a stranger with your bearing is walking the isles, and they are waiting on the cloud bridge.

events.text: {adc_foe} want a small isle with one pavilion and one old keeper. The keeper will not sell. The fleet of cloud ships is already on its way.

events.text: {adc_foe} holds a small world in one hand and drinks its faith like tea. Its people pray harder every year, and get smaller.

events.text: Where the lightning struck, the ground is glass. All around it, {adc_world} is on its knees: soldiers, farmers, an old woman with a basket of eggs. Nobody dares look up at you. Then a small child walks out of the crowd and offers you one of the eggs.

choices.text: Tell them to stand up

effects.log: They stand, slowly. Nobody will tell this story the same way twice.

choices.text: Say nothing, and go

effects.log: You go. Behind you, the silence lasts a long time.

events.text: The isles have stopped drifting. Every immortal in sight is bowing, foreheads to the cloud, and some of them are trembling. They have never seen the seal broken. Most of them did not know there was one.

choices.text: Tell them to stand up

effects.log: They stand, slowly. Nobody will tell this story the same way twice.

choices.text: Say nothing, and go

effects.log: You go. Behind you, the silence lasts a long time.

events.text: Across the domains the gods rise from their thrones and bow, and for a moment there is no politics at all among them. A crack runs across the starry sky where heaven's answer came down. It will take an age to close.

choices.text: Tell them to stand up

effects.log: They stand, slowly. Nobody will tell this story the same way twice.

events.text: A storyteller in a riverside town is telling the legend of {name}. He gets almost everything wrong, and the crowd loves it. When he gets one detail right, you nearly laugh out loud.

choices.text: Join in

effects.log: You join in, a little. It is the most fun you have had in an age.

choices.text: Keep walking

effects.log: You keep walking, smiling.

events.text: A bandit tries to rob you on a mountain road. You are sealed small, but not that small. He leaves with a lecture, a meal and no knife.

choices.text: Step in gently

effects.log: You step in gently. It works, which surprises everyone, including you.

choices.text: Leave them to it

effects.log: You leave them to it. Some things are the world's own business.

events.text: A young immortal is practising a sword form alone on the edge of an isle, badly, and too proud to ask for help. You sit on a rock and watch.

choices.text: Join in

choices.text: Keep walking

effects.log: You keep walking, smiling.

events.text: Two isles have drifted into each other, and their owners are fighting about whose fault it is. It has been going on for nine hundred years.

choices.text: Step in gently

choices.text: Leave them to it

events.text: A forgotten god tends a single lamp in an empty domain. Nobody has prayed to it in an age. It asks if you would like tea.

choices.text: Join in

choices.text: Keep walking

effects.log: You keep walking, smiling.

events.text: Two gods are playing a board game whose pieces are stars. One of them is cheating. Both of them know.

choices.text: Step in gently

effects.log: You step in gently. It works, which surprises everyone, including you.

choices.text: Leave them to it

effects.log: You leave them to it. Some things are the world's own business.

events.text: The stair of light goes up out of {adc_world}, and the world gets small behind you, then green, then gone under the clouds. Whatever you did down there, it is the world's now.

choices.text: Look down once more

effects.log: You look down once more. Somewhere a lamp is lit that would not have been.

choices.text: Look up, and go home

effects.log: You look up, and go home.

events.text: The broken seal falls apart around you in flakes of golden script. Heaven's law takes you home whether you will or no, and {adc_world} watches you go up, and will be afraid of the sky for a generation.

choices.text: Promise yourself it was worth it

effects.log: It was worth it. You are almost sure.

choices.text: Count the cost

effects.log: You count the cost, all the way up.

events.text: Heaven has watched you meddle long enough. A hand of storm comes down through every world at once and lifts you out of {adc_world} like a child out of a pond.

choices.text: Bow to heaven

effects.log: You bow. Heaven does not bow back. It never has.

choices.text: Look heaven in the eye

effects.log: You look heaven in the eye, all the way up. It is the only being left that will meet your gaze.
